name: WA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +12 partisan lean
Longtime incumbent Rick Larsen running with a large fundraising edge
No polls or expert ratings, but prediction markets price Larsen near certain
Republican challenger Edwin Feller shows no fundraising or outside support
model.rationale: The fundamentals point to a Safe D race: a +12 Democratic district, an entrenched incumbent with over $2 million raised, and no visible challenger resources. Prediction markets price Larsen at roughly 97%, consistent with the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Larsen would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Washington's 2nd District leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan advantage of about 12 points. Rick Larsen, the longtime Democratic incumbent, is running for reelection and has raised more than $2 million, holding a substantial cash advantage. His Republican challenger, Edwin Feller, has no reported fundraising or outside support.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, but prediction markets price Larsen's chances at roughly 97 percent. The combination of district lean, incumbency, and financial dominance makes this a Safe Democratic seat, with the main uncertainty being the absence of direct polling rather than any sign of a competitive race.
